scope: Matched-population full-source UV/BF/radiative-rate replay at EXACT native n/nStar/T/ne/rho, source photon centres/f and source widths. Fixed populations throughout; no statistical-equilibrium update. Compare all source/native transition pairs and target level7/top cell identified in the prior outer-layer audit. No fitted parameters, omitted layers or physical model/solar admission. Source-defined native linear ghost spacing and zero chi/S/I upstream plane; length read from actual consumed native mesh, never fitted. No change to source T/ne/rho/populations or rate coefficients. This fixed-population control does not qualify a coupled boundary preconditioner. Exact pre-update population replay against isolated native physical-rate observer. Native baseline binaries unchanged; no physical adoption. Compare exact PRE-update physical native frequency4 state/field. Own source grid remains inherited qscale2; native NQFAC4 and declared decoupled/shared radiation convention explicit, not assumed identical. No SE update or scientific adoption.

source_atom.scope: Source level/f/wavelength/BF units and support checked; imported native LTE and historical-constant HOP background remain explicitly different thermodynamic conventions. Not a self-consistent LTE or observed-model admission.

native_rate_semantics: Unpreconditioned physical rate integrals at exact PRE-update radiation populations; source FP32 contributions summed in FP64, normalized with source profile/LTE factors. Not a post-update fresh native formal solve.
